statements.notes: Pump XXX is a fully dosed, non-stimulant formula designed to fuel nitric oxide production and maximize blood flow for intense muscle pumps.

Includes:
- Cordiart Citrus fruit extract is clinically researched to enhance power output.
-L-Arginine and L-Citrulline fuel nitric oxide production, an important signaling molecule that regulates blood flow.
-resVida Resveratrol is clinically shown to enhance blood vessel dilation for maximum blood flow.
-Creatine helps fuel muscle energy for athletic power, strength and performance.

In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, crossover study, 19 volunteers consumed 3 doses of resVida (30 mg, 90 mg, 270 mg) and a placebo at weekly intervals. Flow-mediated dilation (FMD) of the brachial artery was measured one hour after ingestion of each treatment and was significantly increased at all 3 doses relative to placebo. 30 mg of resVida demonstrated 2.5% greater increased in FMD relative to placebo.
When used in conjunction with an exercise program.
